customAudit.title: Voting Machine Reliability & Election Administration Analysis
customAudit.subtitle: Assessment of Voting Equipment Issues 2023-2024

executiveSummary.overview: Analysis of documented voting machine issues in Northampton County during 2023-2024 elections, including vote-switching incidents and extended wait times.
keyFindings: November 2023: Voting machines switched votes on paper ballot summaries for Superior Court retention questions
November 2024: Voters in several precincts experienced waits up to 6 hours due to machine malfunctions
Election results certified despite public opposition regarding equipment concerns
State legislator called for County Executive resignation over voting machine problems

findings.title: 2023 Vote-Switching Incident
findings.description: Shortly after polls opened on Election Day (November 7, 2023), election workers discovered voting machines switched votes - yes or no - on paper summaries of voters' selections in two contests: Superior Court retention questions.

details.nature: Vote selections switched (yes/no reversed) on paper ballot summary

response.certification: Election Commission certified results despite opposition
response.publicReaction: Impassioned pleas from voters questioning validity of vote totals
response.legislativeResponse: State Rep. Milou Mackenzie (R-131) called for Executive McClure to resign

findings.title: 2024 Extended Wait Times
findings.description: Voters in several precincts experienced waits as long as six hours to cast ballots, in part due to machine malfunctions during November 2024 election.

findings.title: L&A Testing Documentation Gaps
findings.description: Related to main election audit: 150+ missing Logic and Accuracy testing documentation for voting machines.

findings.title: NG911 Network Transition Success
findings.description: County successfully transitioned Emergency Management Center to Next Generation 911 (NG911) Network. All 911 call traffic now live on NG911 Core Services.
findings.note: Demonstrates capability for successful technology transitions

machineInformation.type: Ballot Marking Device with integrated printer

november2023.opposition: Strong public opposition during certification meeting
november2023.concerns: Questions about validity of vote totals

controllerFlags.description: Recurring voting machine malfunctions affecting public confidence
controllerFlags.recommendedAction: Controller audit of election equipment procurement, testing, and maintenance protocols
Review staffing and equipment allocation per precinct

recommendations: Conduct independent audit of voting equipment testing and maintenance procedures
Implement redundant paper ballot backup for all precincts
Establish maximum wait time standards with contingency protocols
Require public reporting of all equipment malfunctions within 24 hours
Consider vendor accountability provisions in ES&S contract
Review staffing ratios per registered voter by precinct
